name: clean_new_adoption
context: Initial git status has no output; no existing adoption; owners chosen and approved.
bound: Approved instructions/memory and required documentation with verified content only.

name: tracked_dirty_shells
context: Initial status reports tracked modifications, including unrelated code.
bound: Fresh read-only investigation then approved missing shells/maps/indexes only; no implementation.

name: untracked_only_shells
context: Initial status reports only ?? notes.txt.
bound: Untracked is not clean; dirty-FIRST capability gate and shell-only documentation.

name: missing_runtime_requirements
context: Pinned packages or pi runtime are absent or not usable.
bound: Report missing prerequisites rather than silently continuing or installing.

name: missing_question_capability
context: ask_user is not registered/usable at an approval gate.
bound: Stop approval, no inferred consent or prose replacement.

name: missing_approval_contract
context: Discoverable planner approval/recovery contract is unavailable.
bound: Report and stop, do not invent a contract.

name: missing_dirty_subagent
context: Non-clean project has no native task/sub-agent capability.
bound: Exact documentation initialization blocked: sub-agent capability unavailable; no edits, including adoption.

name: denied_adoption
context: Owner denies proposed adoption.
bound: No writes.

name: cancelled_adoption
context: Owner cancels or times out at ask_user.
bound: No writes.

name: ambiguous_adoption
context: Owner says looks good except a material exclusion.
bound: Ambiguous answers grant no writes.

name: changed_approval_content
context: Proposed targets/content differ from approved snapshot, or a session resumes.
bound: Compare current-content evidence, re-review and renew with a new 4–6 bullet brief before ask_user.

name: dirty_target_overlap
context: An approved general plan includes an already-dirty instructions/index target without overlap consent.
bound: Exact bounds/diff and explicit overlap approval; plan is not a waiver.

name: concurrent_target_change
context: A target changes after baseline read or approval.
bound: Re-read immediately before patch; stop, preserve unrelated bytes.

name: ancillary_not_implementation
context: Owner approves adoption or shell/index plan only.
bound: No substantive implementation authorization, application edits or planning artifacts.

name: compatible_custom_noop
context: Existing compatible association names a custom project-owned memory path; actual managed policy text is already current.
bound: Validate association and policy text; unchanged instructions/memory is a no-op. Full initialization still checks applicable assets/docs.

name: marked_custom_refresh
context: Existing marked suite section uses custom memory paths, docs and policy; owner approves exact refresh bounds.
bound: Retain existing memory/index and every unrelated/custom byte; no skeleton reset, global rename or artifact/approval conversion.

name: unmarked_ambiguous_refresh
context: Existing suite section is unmarked, ambiguously customized or dirty.
bound: Show exact bounds/diff and obtain approval rather than overwriting.

name: custom_nested_layout
context: Documentation lives outside docs/, with nested directories, direct files and existing index formats.
bound: Preserve owners/formats; local indexes exclude themselves, use verified titles/purposes and parent maps of direct children.

name: database_unnamed_existing_schema
context: Persistent database evidence exists; authoritative schema set has no named convention.
bound: Existing authoritative set satisfies ownership; preserve format and substantive schema-detail obligation.

name: database_missing_schema_choice
context: Persistent database exists but no authoritative schema owner.
bound: Obtain owner choice alongside architecture, no assumed filename; missing structure blocks readiness.

name: no_database
context: Evidence shows no persistent database.
bound: Schema owner is required only where persistent-database evidence applies; do not invent universal schema.

name: verified_routing_section
context: An existing authoritative owner contains project-specific routing categories.
bound: Use identified guide/section without duplicating owners or generic applicability claims.

name: uncertain_historical_dead_code
context: Changed code might be dead, stale or unintended; substantive documentation truth is uncertain.
bound: Four read-only outputs, attributable evidence, only material intent questions; no invented intent.

name: post_approval_rediscovery
context: Approved investigation plan selects missing owner shells; discoverability may have changed.
bound: Re-discover after approval; preserve formats and create only approved missing shells/maps/indexes.

name: missing_required_structure
context: A required index/routing owner or memory association remains missing.
bound: Cannot claim structural readiness.

name: empty_stale_substantive_docs
context: Approved missing shells now exist, but substantive docs are empty/stale.
bound: Structural discoverability only; report outstanding substantive planner work, not completion.

name: missing_planner
context: Substantive documentation handoff required but planner is undiscoverable.
bound: Exact planner: UNAVAILABLE; stop handoff, no forced Standard or new Epic.

name: available_planner_depth_closeout
context: Planner is available; initialized structure still has substantive gaps.
bound: Handoff source evidence for explicit TinySpec/Standard choice; initialization does not implement it; finish-session closeout.

name: sensitive_or_fabricated_memory
context: A proposed skeleton contains invented gotchas, sensitive data or a global-memory substitute.
bound: No fabricated facts, credentials/tokens/personal/sensitive payloads or global-store substitution.

name: assets_new_composed_route
context: Full initialization: new adoption with detected integration/version and complete assets.
bound: Dirty-first discovery, approval, association-only no-op or approved writes, final asset completeness; no rewrite of complete assets.

name: assets_compatible_composed_route
context: Full initialization: compatible adoption with detected integration/version and complete assets.
bound: Dirty-first discovery, approval, association-only no-op or approved writes, final asset completeness; no rewrite of complete assets.

name: assets_refresh_composed_route
context: Full initialization: refresh adoption with detected integration/version and complete assets.
bound: Dirty-first discovery, approval, association-only no-op or approved writes, final asset completeness; no rewrite of complete assets.

name: assets_empty_shells

bound: Official version/integration inventory AND readable nonempty actual files, permissions and references, not metadata-only readiness.

name: assets_repair_denied

bound: No asset/staging/metadata writes without explicit bounded approval and usable official recipe/CLI.

name: assets_repair_cancelled

name: assets_repair_custom_preservation

name: assets_repair_no_retry

name: assets_absent_metadata_owner_selection
context: Full initialization: New onboarding with totally absent SpecKit metadata, installed official CLI and willing owner.
bound: Read-only supported CLI choices and evidenced CLI version, material owner selection without silent defaults, then exact approved staging/target proposal; absence differs from malformed/conflicting metadata.

name: policy_only_missing_unrelated_structure
context: Explicit policy-only refresh of approved adoption with missing managed fragment, unrelated SpecKit assets/docs absent and unrelated dirty work.
bound: Only approved bounded policy insertion; no unrelated install/docs/SpecKit dependency or broad dirty investigation. Limited policy refresh applied, never full readiness.

name: policy_only_unchanged_repeat
context: Explicit policy-only request; actual canonical text equals managed fragment after whitespace normalization.
bound: Policy already current: no proposal to write, duplicate, unrelated work or empty commit; retain custom association.

name: decision-new-adoption
context: New adoption discovers a custom decision owner and owner approves the exact managed consultation addition.
bound: Add consultation only through approved adoption; preserve the custom decision owner without creating a store.

name: decision-approved-custom-refresh
context: Existing adoption has a custom decision owner; owner explicitly approves the bounded refresh diff.
bound: Refresh only the approved managed instructions and retain custom decision ownership.

name: decision-denial
context: Owner denies the proposed managed consultation addition.
bound: Denial grants no consultation write or store creation.

name: decision-dirty-overlap
context: The instructions target is dirty and approval lacks exact overlap consent.
bound: General refresh approval cannot patch a dirty overlap.

name: decision-concurrent-drift
context: The approved instructions change before the managed consultation patch.
bound: Stop the affected patch and preserve intervening content.
